items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Controls/mechanics observed: WASD moves the character; short taps (~0.3-0.5s) move a little, holds of ~1-2.5s move much farther (movement is slow relative to screen). Space performs a contextual harvest/interact on an adjacent object; it only works when very close and the target is not occluded by another object (a grass tuft behind a pine base failed; hovering there showed 'Examine Evergreen' instead). Mouse clicks on world objects select/examine them (e.g., 'Examine Evergreen') and do not harvest; early click did not move/harvest meaningfully. Picked items enter bottom inventory slots after a short animation delay (a ~1s wait confirmed flower, twigs, grass). Twigs dropped on the ground appear to be collected by walking over them (observed a ground twig disappear after moving onto it). Tab toggles the map; the explored area was only a tiny green patch with everything else fogged. Resource objects: flowers (pickable via Space), yellow spiky grass tufts (pick via Space when adjacent), spiky saplings yield twigs (Space; sometimes leave a twig on the ground). Grass tufts were often found at pine-tree bases, which can overlap/occlude them. Birds, rabbit holes, a red bird, and at dusk fireflies were seen; a red-eyed crow appeared at night. Lighting/clock: fireflies appeared around dusk, the screen dimmed progressively, then became fully dark with a starry vignette; being in total darkness ended the run (death) with no light source crafted.

Crafting UI: left sidebar has category icons; top is an axe icon labeled 'Tools' (~y 0.13 of screen), below it a flame icon labeled 'Light' (~y 0.185-0.19), then further icons (trap, sword-like) lower. Clicking a category changes the top-left label to that category name. Despite repeated clicks and hovers on Tools/Light, no recipe flyout or craftable entries ever rendered. Pressing S expecting a keyboard crafting panel merely moved the character down. Pressing C had no observed effect before darkness.

Failed strategies: click-to-harvest (only selects); pressing Space from slightly too far or through a tree; relying on category clicks/hover to reveal recipes (never appeared); assuming a keyboard crafting menu exists (S moved instead).

Unresolved hypotheses (guesses, unconfirmed): recipes may require sufficient ingredients before appearing, or some other interaction (e.g., a craft key/panel) may exist; a torch or campfire likely lives under the Light category and likely needs grass plus twigs; ground drops may auto-pickup on walkover (partly observed). Lesson for next run: prioritize assembling grass and twigs and resolve how to craft/open recipes well before dusk, keep out of total darkness, verify proximity/prompt before pressing Space, and avoid wasting time on repeated attempts at a UI interaction that showed no response.
